title: Midjourney Review (2026)
intro: Midjourney is evaluated here as AI software — Midjourney is a generative image (and video) studio known for distinctive stills. There is no free plan. Published monthly: Basic $10, Standard $30, Pro $60, Mega $120 (annual ~20% off: $8/$24/$48/$96). Fast GPU hours scale by plan; Relax Mode and Stealth Mode gate by tier. Companies over $1M revenue must use Pro or Mega per Midjourney terms. Extra Fast GPU time is $4/hour. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s AI methodology (ease of use, AI job fit, output quality, workflow depth, integrations, governance/privacy, scalability, value, model capability), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
